content: If a contained I - PDU has IpduMContainedTxPduColle c- tionSemantics set to IPDUM_COLLECT_LAST_IS_BEST , the Container PDU is a s- sembled and if a PduR_IpduMTriggerTransmit returns E_NOT_OK for a contained I - PDU, IpduM shall omit this contained I - PDU silently an d proceed with the assembly of the Container PDU .

If a contained I-PDU has IpduMContainedTxPduCollec- tionSemantics IPDUM_COLLECT_LAST_IS_BEST , the Container PDU is assem- bled and if a PduR_IpduMTriggerTransmit returns E_NOT_OK for a contained I- PDU, IpduM shall omit this contained I-PDU silently and proceed with the assembly of the Container PDU.
